parameters.name: gatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the AI gateway instance. The target instance must exist, belong to the current account, and be of the AI gateway type.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: The fuzzy match keyword for the model provider identifier or model name. If left empty, all model cards under the current gateway are queried.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Default value: 1. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 500.
